name: JSON Schema
summary: Declarative, JSON-encoded vocabulary for describing, annotating and validating JSON documents; a schema is a set of keyword constraints (assertions, applicators, annotations) applied to an instance, with URI-based identification and referencing of subschemas.

level_notes.0: There is no single reference implementation. The official JSON-Schema-Test-Suite is the de-facto conformance suite and the Bowtie harness reports every implementation's results against it; ajv (JavaScript, compiles schemas to code), python-jsonschema, Hyperjump, santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema (Go), jsonschema-rs and networknt (Java) are widely used independent validators.
level_notes.1: Published as a series of IETF Internet-Drafts that never became RFCs ('draft-04', 'draft-06', 'draft-07', '2019-09', '2020-12'); the dialect meta-schemas are normative companions. Since 2022 the project has decoupled from the IETF process and is preparing a self-published stable release (see the ADRs in json-schema-spec).
level_notes.2: 'Understanding JSON Schema' (hosted on json-schema.org) is the standard book-length guide; learnjsonschema.com documents every keyword of every dialect.
